title: Crab
wikitext:
[[image:Crab.png|thumb|]]
A (typically) small crustacean that is often found on beaches.  Crabs have high armor, as the shell would imply.  Crabs are typically neutral and are ignored by passerby.  They drop [[Crawler Meat]], used to make [[Crab Cake]]s.  Crabs are found in [[Durotar]], [[The Barrens]], [[Darkshore]], [[Westfall]], [[Blackfathom Deeps]], [[Ashenvale]], [[Desolace]], [[Stranglethorn Vale]], and the [[Swamp of Sorrows]].

*Not skinnable.

Types of '''Crabs''':
*Silithid Protector
*Surf Crawler
*Reef Crawler
*Sand Crawler
*Spider Crab

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
[[Image:SpiderCrab.jpg|right|thumb|Spider Crab from Warcraft III]]
* Have high armor, medium attack, and low HP.
* Eats Bread, Fish, and Fungus, making them easy to feed.
* Can learn [[Cower]], [[Growl]], and [[Claw]].  They have yet to recieve their species skill.
* Not very popular as a Hunter pet.  Their low profile makes them ideal for seeing around in groups.
